== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Seven Calamities are the primary leaders of the [[D’Niss]], an alien species. They are considered the most formidable beings of their kind, surpassed in power only by the [[Swarm-Queen]], [[Esh’kinaar]]. Their primary objective is to amass sufficient strength to facilitate the summoning of this queen. Individually, these entities are exceptionally dangerous; engaging even a single member would necessitate the combined strength of all five [[Divine Titans]] or a [[Zenith Device]]. The group includes various members such as [[Neth’terith]], also known as the [[Shadow]] Claw, who can produce clouds of parasites; [[Sel’miroth]], a small but potent hypnotist and spellcaster; and [[Xarro’kesh]], a massive three-headed ant. Other members have included a beetle-like creature larger than an entire colony. Throughout the conflict, the group was systematically reduced until only three members remained hiding on inhabited planets, eventually leaving [[Sel’miroth]] as the final survivor before her death.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Seven Calamities are a category of powerful threats or events consisting of various entities, including [[Sel’miroth]] and a fat beetle. While most members of this group eventually departed from the universe, three survivors were discovered within the same system as [[Esh’kinaar]]. Following these events, the final member of the Seven Calamities resonated through the [[Aether]] with a song of triumph.}}
